bootstrap: stored summary bootstraps seed-level differences (rng seed 7321, B=2000); matched seeds are not exact common random numbers after paths diverge (stated in DESIGN)
not_implemented_per_design: rural/urban migration: no migration flow in engine or experiment (rural is a household attribute + cost)
realistic data fit / historical event dates / observed places: not attempted
tutoring cost/distribution and employer credential requirements as estimated quantities: not estimated

mechanical_exposure.note: Both interventions are absent in `none` and both are eventually on in all three intervention arms, so the arms differ in CUMULATIVE EXPOSURE as well as order: school_first has more education-share-years and fewer vacancy-years than jobs_first by construction, and simultaneous has the most of both. The engine also lags the fiscal channel by one year (budget from this year's revenue is spent next year) while vacancies act in the event year, so 'simultaneous' is not simultaneous in effect.

causal_language: No causal claim: schedules are stipulated changes in a synthetic model; the arms are not exposure-matched; time order is not identified; migration is not simulated.
